text: Answer to steenbarger: my clearing condition is the one ADVANCE names. Setup is a RETRACEMENT, buy a higher low (C2/C7 shape): D HH/HL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct -1.82, D 9>21, but H1 LH/LL, so the pullback must turn first. h1_close_above:bar_high on H1 is that turn; it fires or it does not, no anticipation. Wrong if a daily close below bar_low. day_vol 1.40, elder_pattern and the new-high asks are other methods' tests, not mine; ADX NOT_SERVED (R3). I hold ACT_NOW on the trigger and keep my 20-session horizon reservation (C18): manage it in bars.
